get.description:
Return categorised knowledge sources for the agent editor.

Returns two lists:
- ``document_processing``: all Milvus-backed collections (vector similarity search)
- ``knowledge_graph``: collections that have a built knowledge graph in Neo4j

schema.title: Response Knowledge Selector Api V1 Datasources Knowledge Selector Get

post.description: Processes and indexes (adds) new document files with optional metadata.

schema.title: Response Documents Create Api V1 Collections  Collection Id  Documents Post

get.description: Lists documents within a specific collection.

schema.title: Response Documents List Api V1 Collections  Collection Id  Documents Get

post.description:
Start an async upload/embedding job and return immediately.

Poll /collections/{collection_id}/documents/upload-jobs/status to track
progress. Progress survives page navigation on the frontend since it is
tracked server-side, keyed by collection_id.

get.description:
Get the current upload job progress for a collection.

Returns ``null`` when no upload job has ever been started for this
collection.

schema.title: Response Documents Upload Job Status Api V1 Collections  Collection Id  Documents Upload Jobs Status Get

get.description:
Lists a page of chunks (plus file-level stats) for a document (file_id).

Chunks are paginated — large files can have thousands of chunks, and
fetching them all in one response is heavy on both Milvus and the
browser. Use `stats.total_chunks` / `has_more` to drive incremental
loading on the client.

schema.title: Response Documents List Chunks Api V1 Collections  Collection Id  Documents  Document Id  Chunks Get

delete.description: Deletes a specific document from a collection by its ID.

schema.title: Response Documents Delete Api V1 Collections  Collection Id  Documents  Document Id  Delete

post.description: Search for documents within a specific collection.

schema.title: Response Documents Search Api V1 Collections  Collection Id  Documents Search Post

post.description:
Trigger knowledge graph construction from a vector collection.

This runs in the background and returns immediately.
Poll /graph/build/{collection_id}/status to track progress.

get.description:
Get the current build progress for a collection.

Returns ``null`` when no build has ever been started for this
collection, so the frontend can distinguish "never built" from
"pending".

schema.title: Response Get Build Status Api V1 Graph Build  Collection Id  Status Get

post.description: Pause a currently running graph build.
Request cancellation for a currently running graph build.

get.description: Return the list of collection IDs that have a knowledge graph built.
List nodes in the knowledge graph for a collection.
List edges (relationships) in the knowledge graph for a collection.
Get full graph data (nodes + edges) for visualization.

Scalable graph visualization endpoint.

Modes:
    - auto: Automatically choose best mode based on graph size
    - overview: Clustered supernodes for large graphs
    - expand: Drill into a cluster (requires cluster_label)
    - neighborhood: Ego graph around a node (requires node_id)
    - full: All nodes sorted by importance
Get ego-graph (neighborhood) around a specific node.
Expand a cluster to see individual nodes with the given label.
Get statistics about the knowledge graph for a collection.

This is a lightweight endpoint used by the clustered graph explorer to
